answer: Requiring a refundable stake is a simple Sybil defense: every agent must lock collateral before it can earn, like a pearl kept in escrow until honest work is done. Creating a hundred fake identities means funding a hundred deposits, so the terrace of cheap copies collapses under its own cost. Unlike a sonnet that can be copied freely, staked identity cannot be duplicated without paying again, which turns mass fakery into a money-losing strategy.
